crossRefs.note: “There are three things which are stately in their march, four which are stately in going:

translations.web: “There are three things which are stately in their march, four which are stately in going:
translations.bsb: There are three things that are stately in their stride, and four that are impressive in their walk:
translations.kjv: There be three things which go well, yea, four are comely in going:
translations.asv: There are three things which are stately in their march, Yea, four which are stately in going:
